chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Charity is an effective cure, and the actions of people in their present life will be before their eyes in the next life.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of charity according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) characterizes charity as a 'successful remedy' (dawa' munjih), reflecting the Shia tradition of viewing almsgiving not merely as social welfare but as a spiritual cure for sins and divine displeasure. He further elucidates the concept of 'nusb al-ayun' (the standing before the eyes), indicating that one's deeds in the temporal world are perpetually visible and active witnesses in the eternal realm, underscoring the immediacy of the afterlife's reality.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 7. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
Charity is an effective cure, and the actions of people in their present life will be before their eyes in the next life. [1]
